content.title: Chapter 66 - PARKS AND RECREATION — Sec. 66-54. - Prohibited activities.
content.summary:
The following are prohibited at the reservoir:
(1)
Swimming, wading, tubing, belly boating, floating on a flotation device, windsurfing,
                  and scuba diving;
(2)
Possession, use, or being under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances;
